subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text :
stimulus: "Why did you not go to school yesterday?" said the mother to the girl. "I was ill mom," the girl replied. "How are you today?" The mother asked again. "Well" said the girl. "Don't worry for me." ইংরেজি দ্বিতীয় পত্র  113
guide_solution: The mother asked the girl why she (G) had not gone to school the previous day. The girl replied that she (G) had been ill. The mother asked her again how she (G) was that day. The girl replied that she was well. She further told her mother not to worry for her (G).
